preverification_events.description: Multiple individuals in yellow jumpsuits engage in physical combat: one person is seen grabbing and throwing another over a table, while others grapple and strike nearby.

A large group of individuals in yellow hazmat suits and others in dark tactical gear are engaged in chaotic, violent movement within a multi-level industrial facility; some individuals are seen raising arms, lunging, and clashing, indicating collective violent unrest.

Widespread violent unrest erupts in the cafeteria: groups of inmates in yellow uniforms are actively fighting, overturning tables, and moving chaotically; the scene shows collective violent disorder beyond isolated fights.

Multiple figures in dark tactical gear are visibly holding firearms and aiming them toward the central figure and other yellow-suited individuals; muzzle flashes or weapon discharge are not directly visible, but sustained aiming posture and context strongly indicate active shooting during the riot.

rejected.reason: No mutual physical combat visible; background figures appear to be raising hands or moving away, not engaging in fighting.
The crowd is largely stationary or moving orderly; no collective violent unrest, destruction, or aggression is observed across the interval.
Same as candidate 1: no evidence of rioting—no throwing, clashing, or coordinated violence; individuals are seated, standing, or walking calmly.
No visible firearms discharge, muzzle flash, or bullet impact; figures holding objects do not show shooting motion or effect; the scene remains static with no ballistic evidence.
